additions.description: GET /profiles supports filtering by any nutritional field
additions.reasoning: The specification only mentions that GET /profiles may specify a query string of the form 'field=value' but does not specify which fields can be used for filtering. The code allows filtering by any nutritional field.
The specification does not mention any sorting capability for GET /profiles, but the code sorts the results by 'user_id'.
The specification does not explicitly state whether POST /profiles requires all nutritional fields or allows partial fields. The code allows partial fields and defaults missing fields to 0.0.
